sloka: तं तु दृष्ट्वा बलात्तेन नीयमानं महारणात् ।महेन्द्रममराः सर्वे किं नु स्यादित्यचिन्तयन् ।। ७.२९.३० ॥
transliteration: taṁ tu dṛṣṭvā balāttena nīyamānaṁ mahāraṇāt ।mahendramamarāḥ sarve kiṁ nu syādityacintayan ।। 7.29.30 ॥

translations.english: Having seen the great Indra being led away by force from the great battle by him, all the gods wondered what would happen next.
